pricing.headline: Printed prices. Month to month.
pricing.noSurpriseBody: Every plan has a hard spend cap. When you hit it we pause the line and tell you — we never quietly bill past it.

audit.headline: What is your phone costing you?
audit.sub: We'll listen to how your line answers today and send you the gaps.

items.a: Each call rounds up to the next whole minute, then they're added together. A 20-second call costs one minute. That's it — no connection fees, no per-number surcharge.

items.q: What happens if I go over?
items.a: You're billed the overage rate printed on your plan, up to a hard cap. At the cap we pause the line and tell you, rather than letting the bill keep climbing.
Voice, Telegram and email are live. Instagram receives messages into your Inbox. Messenger, WhatsApp, SMS and web chat are in beta and are not part of any plan yet.
Month to month. Cancel from the billing page and it stops at the end of the period. There is no contract to get out of.
You do. Calls, transcripts, contacts and appointments belong to your workspace, and you can export them.

channels.title: Where it works

channels.notInPlan: Not included in any plan yet.
